notes: Black fascia board over the door of a period kiosk at the Norsk Folkemuseum (open-air museum, Oslo), so the shop is a museum exhibit. Many vintage advert distractors: PLAZA så klart!, TIEDEMANNS TEDDY / ALLEMANNS VENN, DRIKK Coca-Cola (disc and sandwich board 'FRUKT / TOBAKK'), Hjemmet, SOUTH STATE, TOY tyggegummi poster, NORSK TIPPING plate and 'Åpen' door sign. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Psyq
attribution: Photo: Psyq, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kirkegata_kirkenes_norway.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Kirkenes: two stacked street-name plates on a pole, Norwegian above and a Cyrillic transliteration below, shot from below at an angle; Kirkenes church tower behind. Tiny 'BF 00' maker mark at the lower left of the upper plate.

author: HMPinnsvinet
attribution: Photo: HMPinnsvinet, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Carl_Konows_gate_DSC_0448.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Bergen (Gyldenpris): white enamel street plate on a whitewashed wall, slight angle. Below it a blue oval namesake plaque 'CARL KONOW / 1806 - 1876 / KJØPMANN OG STORTINGSREPRESENTANT' (distractor, small curved text).

author: Kimberli Mäkäräinen
attribution: Photo: Kimberli Mäkäräinen, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%C3%84%CA%B9vv_sign_2.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Neiden: brown tourist direction sign pointing right with a museum pictogram, trilingual Norwegian / Skolt Sami (sms, ISO 639-3) / Finnish. The Skolt Sami line uses the prime letter U+02B9 (ʹ) after Ä, a and u; it looks like an acute mark on the sign. Slight blur.
source_categories: Trilingual Finnish-Norwegian-Skolt Sami signs in Norway
